premises.text: Insurance commissions cannot be rebated, so value must be delivered as free services
premises.evidence_span: I can't give you guys money back, but what I can do is provide a whole lot of services and software for free on my platform

premises.text: Free platform runs payroll, benefits, and HR admin funded by those commissions
premises.evidence_span: We do all of it for free, because we make money on the insurance commissions

premises.text: Broker-of-record change collects commissions without altering client plans or cards
premises.evidence_span: Nothing changes about your plans. Nothing changes about your pricing. Your insurance cards all stay the same

premises.text: Existing systems connect in seconds with two-way payroll sync
premises.evidence_span: We import all the information. It takes about 30 seconds

premises.text: Hiring flow auto-generates docs, collects payroll/tax/bank data, verifies eligibility, and enrolls benefits
premises.evidence_span: we walk them through a process where we get them enrolled in your health insurance plan and your 401k

premises.text: Administrative HR share makes free outsourcing rational
premises.evidence_span: if we can take all these headaches off your hands, that's got to be something that's got to make sense for you to switch to us

value.text: Disruptive free HR and benefits platform that clients switch to
value.evidence_span: we are going to mess stuff up for two very large industries by redefining what it is that insurance brokers do for their clients

causal_links.evidence_span: we collect all of the commission revenue on the account going forward
why wouldn't you switch to us

notes: P3->P2: broker-of-record is presented as what enables commission-funded free service. Industry disruption framing kept as value wording, not a vision premise.
